supplierKPIs.worker_issue_summary: The workers reported that, every pay check for the past 3 pay periods, their employer has not been paying their wages fully. And also, the wages have been paid very late. Previously they used to get paid at the end of the second and fourth weeks of the month, and it has become quite erratic.
supplierKPIs.issara_action: We spoke with our HR officer focal point, who was a bit defensive but she acknowledged that payments may have been late due to the company themselves not having been paid by one of their main customers unexpectedly. We asked how the issue would be reconciled and she noted that the owed balance could be added to the next pay check.
supplierKPIs.supplier_action: Remediate the issue and pay the owed balance in the next pay check which is scheduled for this Friday, and, communicate clearly to the workers in Burmese what the reason was, what to expect, and what to do if the pay amount seems incorrect.

supplierKPIs.description: Issue with wages: unethical but not illegal
remediation_sp_recommendation: SP should engage with the factory at the policy and management level to encourage a review of wage practices and promote alignment with responsible sourcing standards. While the wages may comply with legal requirements, buyers should encourage the supplier to assess whether current practices are fair and ethical and to explore opportunities for improvement. Buyers can reinforce expectations through their supplier codes of conduct and responsible purchasing commitments, encouraging the factory to strengthen transparency and fairness in wage practices.
